analytic_target.statement: Prove a two-variable oscillatory estimate on the unbalanced (r,q') box that absorbs the quantified determinant loss.

claim_boundary: This artifact proves the factored Hessian and trivial small-endpoint split only. It proves no two-variable sum, full packet, recurrence, powered, density, or interval gain.

curvature_restoration.statement: For fixed stationary k, det Hess_(r,q') Psi(rq',k)=exp(4pi x)-1, positive off the ell=0 endpoint.

endpoint_split.statement: Packet uniqueness makes ell blocks below exponent 6/25-kappa subcritical; the weakest surviving determinant exponent is -9/25-kappa.

exact_replay.gate: prove a two-variable factored exponential-sum estimate with determinant loss X^(9/25+kappa), or improve the small-endpoint split
exact_replay.nondegeneracy: positive for every x>0; asymptotic to 4*pi*x as x tends to zero
exact_replay.small_ell_branch: ell blocks with lambda<6/25-kappa contain fewer packets than the target by uniqueness alone
exact_replay.surviving_curvature: on lambda>=6/25-kappa, determinant exponent is at least -9/25-kappa

prior_context.prior_role: restore a product variable projected away by complete frequency folding
